title: @rethunk/mcp-multi-root-git: git_show
description: Parameter schema for the 'git_show' MCP tool.

workspaceRoot.description: Repo path. Default: first MCP root / cwd.

ref.description: Commit reference (SHA, branch, tag, or ancestor notation like "HEAD~3", "main^2").

path.description: Optional single file path to inspect at the ref. Merged with `paths` when both are provided.

paths.description: Optional list of file paths (max 256) to filter the shown diff/stat. Merged with `path` when both are provided.

stat.description: When true, show --stat diffstat (files changed summary) instead of the full patch.

maxBytes.description: Max UTF-8 bytes of diff/stat content to return (default 512000), cut at a line boundary. Oversized output is truncated with truncated:true.
